title: 14 June 2013: Paul McCartney live at Bonnaroo Festival
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the 2013 Bonnaroo Music Festival in Great Stage Park, Manchester, Tennessee, USA, on 14 June 2013.

It was the 13th show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015, and the first festival date of the tour.

psuper psyched to play #Bonnaroo2013 in less than an hour with Paul and the guys.. It's beautiful night for music.

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) June 15, 2013

https://instagram.com/p/ajtphPO6Ph/

McCartney improvised a song for the Bonnaroo audience during the set.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

thanks for the great vibes bonnaroo! amazing festival energy, & we lucked out with the perfect weather.

— Rusty Anderson (@rustyanderson1) June 17, 2013
